statement: The fixed /return entry verifies or safely falls back using the required machine code plus optional order and mobile evidence, issues an automatic short-lived HttpOnly session when needed, and exposes neither a manual link token nor order-enumeration detail.

A customer can submit a required machine code and waybill through the one-page return form, optionally upload up to ten private photos, and receive an ACCEPTED or REVIEW_REQUIRED receipt without duplicate business writes.
Files are stored in private RustFS through the existing infra_file boundary and cannot be attached across registrations or tenants.
A valid submission creates or reuses one RETURN delivery without changing device, order, inspection, or schedule lifecycle state.
The admin can page, inspect, and review return registrations with permission and tenant isolation.
An authorized administrator can edit only mutable device metadata while immutable identity and lifecycle fields remain server-controlled.
An authorized administrator can logically delete only an available device with no source or business-history references, with permission-controlled UI and server-side confirmation rules.

An authorized tenant administrator can manage the tenant-scoped device category and model catalog, create devices from a valid category-model-prefix combination, and receive a normalized unique device number without affecting ERP sequence allocation.
